snippet.title: The Holoween Collection 3.0 - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The Holoween collection is a set of 5 games featuring HoloMyth's halloween costumes from the Holoween stream!

Play the game for free on windows or in your browser here: https://callmemonamiral.itch.io/holoween-collection

- Dr. Oopsie's evil laboratory of dangerous experimentations is a puzzle game where you inject weird stuff in Takodachis!
- Murderous Malpractice is a first-person horror game set in a spooky hospital!
- Midnight Snack is a stealth game about sneakily drinking villagers' blood!
- Pumpkin Party is a hectic first-person shooter against living pumpkins!
- Gawrzilla attacks! is an action game about destroying buildings until the army launches nukes!
